WITH txn AS (
  SELECT p.psp_reference, p.eur_amount, p.card_scheme, p.is_credit, p.aci,
    IF(p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country, 1, 0) AS intracountry
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  WHERE p.merchant = 'Crossfit_Hanna' AND p.year = 2023
),
rules AS (
  SELECT * FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code) m WHERE m = 5999)
),
matched AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, t.eur_amount, r.ID, r.fixed_amount, r.rate
  FROM txn t
  JOIN rules r
    ON (r.card_scheme IS NULL OR r.card_scheme = t.card_scheme)
   AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(r.account_type),0) = 0 OR 'F' IN UNNEST(r.account_type))
   AND (r.capture_delay IS NULL OR r.capture_delay = 'manual')
   AND (r.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR r.monthly_fraud_level = '>8.3%')
   AND (r.monthly_volume IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume = '100k-1m')
   AND (r.is_credit IS NULL OR r.is_credit = t.is_credit)
   AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(r.aci),0) = 0 OR t.aci IN UNNEST(r.aci))
   AND (r.intracountry IS NULL OR r.intracountry = t.intracountry)
),
per_txn AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, ANY_VALUE(eur_amount) AS eur_amount, COUNT(*) AS n_rules, MIN(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000) AS fee_min, MAX(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000) AS fee_max
  FROM matched GROUP BY psp_reference
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM txn) AS total_txn,
  COUNT(*) AS matched_txn,
  SUM(IF(n_rules > 1, 1, 0)) AS multi_match_txn,
  SUM(fee_min) AS fees_min_total,
  SUM(fee_max) AS fees_max_total
FROM per_txn

    IF(issuing_country = acquirer_country, 1, 0) AS intra
  FROM base b JOIN monthly m USING (mo)
),
mccs AS (SELECT 7997 AS mcc UNION ALL SELECT 5999),
matched AS (
  SELECT mc.mcc, t.rid, t.eur_amount, f.ID, f.fixed_amount, f.rate

    AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)

    AND (f.merchant_category_code IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code) = 0 OR mc.mcc IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
    AND (f.account_type IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type) = 0 OR 'F' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
    AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = 'manual')
    AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = t.vol_band)
    AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = t.fraud_band)
    AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = t.intra)
),
first_rule AS (
  SELECT mcc, rid, eur_amount, ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(ID, fixed_amount, rate) ORDER BY ID LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS r

),
fees_by_mcc AS (
  SELECT mcc, COUNT(*) AS txns, SUM(r.fixed_amount + r.rate * eur_amount / 10000) AS fee FROM first_rule GROUP BY mcc

WITH tx AS (

    (p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country) AS is_intra,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL p.day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS mon
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  WHERE p.merchant = 'Crossfit_Hanna' AND p.year = 2023
),
ms AS (
  SELECT mon, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol,
    100 * SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fraud_pct
  FROM tx GROUP BY mon
),
txb AS (
  SELECT t.*, m.vol, m.fraud_pct,
    CASE WHEN m.vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN m.vol < 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN m.vol < 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_bucket,
    CASE WHEN m.fraud_pct < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN m.fraud_pct <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN m.fraud_pct <= 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fraud_bucket

),
r AS (
  SELECT * FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`
  WHERE 5999 IN UNNEST(merchant_category_code) OR merchant_category_code IS NULL
),
j AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, t.eur_amount, r.ID, (r.fixed_amount + r.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000) AS fee
  FROM txb t
  LEFT JOIN r ON (r.card_scheme IS NULL OR r.card_scheme = t.card_scheme)
    AND (r.account_type IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(r.account_type) = 0 OR 'F' IN UNNEST(r.account_type))
    AND (r.capture_delay IS NULL OR r.capture_delay = 'manual')

),
monthly AS (
  SELECT mon, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol, SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) AS fvol
  FROM tx GROUP BY mon
),
txm AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, t.eur_amount, t.card_scheme, t.is_credit, t.aci, t.intra,
    CASE WHEN m.vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN m.vol <= 1000000 THEN '100k-1m'

    CASE WHEN m.fvol / m.vol * 100 < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN m.fvol / m.vol * 100 <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%'

  FROM tx t JOIN monthly m USING (mon)
),
scen AS (SELECT mcc FROM UNNEST([7997, 5999]) AS mcc),
matched AS (
  SELECT s.mcc, t.psp_reference, t.eur_amount, f.ID, f.fixed_amount, f.rate
  FROM txm t
  CROSS JOIN scen s
  CROSS JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
  WHERE (f.card_scheme IS NULL OR f.card_scheme = t.card_scheme)
    AND (f.account_type IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type) = 0 OR 'F' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))

    AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = t.vb)
    AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = t.fb)
    AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)

),

    SUM(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000) AS total_fee
  FROM matched GROUP BY mcc
)

  (SELECT SUM(total_fee) FROM per_scen WHERE mcc = 5999) - (SELECT SUM(total_fee) FROM per_scen WHERE mcc = 7997) AS delta_5999_minus_7997
